title: Fix setup-go dependency caching for Go modules without go.sum
notes: ReadyLit run 45309110094 passed the Go gate but setup-go skipped the cache because the generated workflow referenced only the absent go.sum.
done_when: Generated workflows key the cache from the module-specific go.mod and include go.sum when it exists. Root and nested modules have regression coverage.
result: Fix setup-go dependency caching for Go modules without go.sum
evidence: The scaffold regression failed before the fix and passes for root and nested modules. The pinned setup-go hashFiles dependency hashes go.mod without go.sum, invalidates the key when either file changes, and isolates nested paths. The rebuilt codeality-go gate passed all seven stages on the tool and the template.
